item.title: Backend Lead (Node.js)
item.description:
Шукаємо Backend Lead, який очолить Backend Department і відповідатиме як за розвиток команди, так і за технічний розвиток усього backend-напряму.

 

Zeely — AI Marketing Platform із 2M+ користувачів, яка допомагає бізнесам створювати рекламні креативи й UGC-відео, запускати кампанії в Meta/TikTok та працювати з маркетинговою аналітикою в одному продукті.

 

Зараз ми переходимо від B2C до B2B/SMB, активно масштабуємо продукт і Backend Department, у якому вже 10+ інженерів. Шукаємо сильного технічного лідера, який поєднує people management із глибоким розумінням backend-архітектури та highload-систем.

 

Що буде у твоєму фокусі:

  • розвиток backend-команди: planning, mentoring, code review та performance management;
  • архітектура, scalability, reliability та observability backend-платформи;
  • розвиток AI Gateway та orchestration layer для роботи з різними AI-моделями й провайдерами;
  • масштабування сервісів та інфраструктури під зростання продукту й навантаження;
  • розвиток нових AI-напрямів: RAG, MCP та AI-агенти;
  • технічні стандарти, якість коду, performance та operational reliability;

  • тісна співпраця з Principal System Architect, DevOps, AI Engineering, Frontend, Mobile та QA.

     

Що для нас важливо:

  • 7+ років комерційного досвіду з Node.js;
  • 3+ роки досвіду як Lead / Team Lead / Engineering Manager;
  • сильний production-досвід із NestJS, PostgreSQL та Redis;
  • практичний досвід із мікросервісами та highload-системами;
  • AWS, Docker, message queues та observability;
  • досвід проєктування масштабованих і надійних систем;
  • розуміння incident management та production ownership;

  • English — Upper-Intermediate+.

     

Буде плюсом:

  • AI API integrations та multi-model orchestration;
  • RAG, embeddings, MCP або AI-агенти;
  • Terraform / GCP / Cloudflare;
  • payments;
  • досвід масштабування та найму engineering-команд;

  • AWS certification.

     

Ми активно використовуємо AI-assisted development, але для нас критично важливий сильний engineering mindset: розуміння архітектури, якості коду, testing/debugging та відповідальність за результат.

 

Формат: remote-first + офіси у Варшаві та Києві.

 

Процес:
Intro Call → Test Task → Technical Interview → Final Interview → Reference Check → Offer

 

Надсилай резюме — будемо раді познайомитися 💚

item.title: Senior AI-Integrated Full Stack Engineer
item.description:
About the Client

 

Our client is a fast-growing deep-tech startup building advanced solutions for monitoring large-scale critical infrastructure. Their technology combines innovative fiber-optic sensing with machine learning to turn existing optical fiber into a real-time distributed sensor, helping monitor infrastructure such as power grids, pipelines, railways, roads, and other critical assets.

 

They are building a scalable, cloud-native platform designed to solve real-world, high-impact problems. Their culture is product-driven, fast-paced, and ownership-oriented. They value strong engineers who think like builders, move fast, and care deeply about quality.

 

We are looking for a Senior AI-Integrated Full Stack Engineer to join our client’s applications engineering team. You will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling their platform end-to-end — from intuitive frontend experiences to robust backend services and cloud infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Do

 

* Design and implement scalable, high-performance web applications end-to-end

* Be part of an intensive transformation to modern AI work methodology using the latest AI models.

* Architect backend services and APIs and build modern, responsive frontend applications.

* Be part of complex technical discussions with the ability to contribute a major part to the discussion and decisions.

* Own features from concept to production

* Optimize performance, reliability, and security across the stack as well as promote engineering best practices

 

What You Bring

 

* 5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer.

* Proven experience in development using AI as the main working tool.

* Proven experience with the relevant technologies and frameworks.

* Strong understanding of system design (experience with Chakra UI is an advantage), scalability, and cloud architecture

* Proven experience working with AWS in production environments

* Fluent in English and strong communication skills.

* You embrace change and learning on the go.

* Experience working in startup or fast-paced environments.

* Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset.

 

Our Client’s Tech Stack

 

* Full stack: Next.js, NestJS (Typescript)

* System design: ChakraUI

* Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines

* Database: SQL / NoSQL (depending on service)

* Cloud: AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, etc.)

 

AI & Modern Engineering Expectations

 

Candidates must be proficient and up-to-date with the latest AI advancements, actively using AI-powered development tools (like Claude Code, Code Rabbit, or similar) to accelerate development, enhance code quality, and innovate product features where AI adds user value.

 

Nice to Have

 

* Experience with Spec-Driven-Development and methodologies to support full AI embracement

* Experience designing and developing microservices architecture.

* Experience with Python and Dash.

* Background in performance optimization and distributed systems

item.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Boosters)
item.description:
Our promotional features team is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer. This role is focused on developing and optimising promotional features for our gaming platforms, where performance, scalability, and cutting-edge solutions are paramount.


If you’re a product-passionate person, your mind is keen to solve deep tech engineering problems, and you have a fast “PoC first” approach with a deep sense of ownership, we would love to hear from you.

 

Main Responsibilities

 

– Develop and maintain robust backend systems for our promotional features

– Optimize existing systems for enhanced performance and scalability

– Lead technical decisions and contribute to our SaaS solutions

– Collaborate with distributed teams to innovate and implement new features

– Ensure code and architectural excellence through reviews

– Address complex technical challenges with innovative solutions

– Participating in on-call rotations within the squad to help ensure the reliability and availability of our systems

 

Mandatory Requirements

 

– Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript (our primary backend stack). We’re also open to strong backend engineers from other ecosystems (e.g., Go, Java, Python, C#, C++) who are ready to ramp up quickly

– Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency patterns

– Experience building distributed systems and working with messaging and coordination tools (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, distributed locks)

– Experience with gRPC in production environments

– Solid knowledge of databases: relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL), columnar (ClickHouse), and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB)

– Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and Kubernetes

– Skilled in building and maintaining unit and end-to-end tests

– Proven track record of delivering production-ready solutions

– Experience working with large-scale microservices architectures

– Degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

 

Nice to Have

 

– Understanding of enterprise development patterns

– Experienced with large-scale microservices architecture

– Experience with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, etc.)

– Active performance observation

– Gambling domain experience

– Understanding of application security and industry standards, its best practice

 

We offer

 

– Competitive Salary

– Quarterly Bonuses

– Unlimited Paid Time Off

– Unlimited Paid Sick Leave

– Remote & Flexible Working

– Private Medical Insurance

– Financial Support for Life Events

– Professional Development Budget

– International Exposure

– Regular Company Events

*Benefits may vary depending on location and contractual agreement

item.title: Sr FullStack (Node.js 60%, React 40%)
item.description:
This role is more focused on backend development with Node.js and TypeScript, but it also requires React experience so you can handle your frontend tasks independently rather than relying on a frontend developer.

 

Infrastructure and production environments are handled by a separate DevOps team, so your focus will remain on application development rather than production support or infrastructure management.

 

Responsibilities

  1. Design, develop, and maintain backend services throughout the full development lifecycle
  2. Assist with frontend implementation when needed to deliver product features
  3. Release new functionality and monitor feature stability after deployment
  4. Work closely with Product, Platform, and Reliability teams
  5. Contribute to technical improvements and enhancements within the existing architecture

 

Tech Stack

Node.js, TypeScript, React, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka/RabbitMQ, monitoring and observability tools

 

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Experience with React and modern frontend engineering practices
  • Solid experience with databases, caching, and data management approaches
  • Experience investigating and resolving issues in distributed environments
  • A product ownership mindset, with the ability to take features from concept to production
  • English communication skills for daily collaboration and team meetings

 

Nice to Have

Experience with microservice architectures and API development

Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

Knowledge of application performance tuning and optimization

Basic understanding of Linux and networking

Familiarity with clean architecture principles and testing methodologies

 

What the Company Offers

  • Fully remote work environment with a flexible schedule
  • Paid vacation and days off
  • Salary reviews twice a year
  • B2B/contractor cooperation model with accounting support
  • An opportunity to work on a large-scale product and influence technical direction
